note: The Simulation workspace: switch to it, open each study's setup dialog, and come back to Design with the design untouched. Airflow's OK asks for the inlets first; the Aerodynamics and Gas Dynamics solvers are not built, so they are refused; nothing changes.
Into Simulation through the control channel, as an agent would.
Airflow Study: a docked dialog with the body, inlet and outlet pickers; OK with only the body picked asks for the inlets.
Aerodynamics Study and Gas Dynamics Study, the same way.
The engine checks a study run directly too: Airflow needs its inlets, Gas Dynamics its body.
Back to Design: same body, same volume, nothing to undo.
